title: Build for What Comes Next: The 2026 Virtual Launch
title_zh: 面向未来的造物 · 2026 线上发布会全片
summary: From the 14th-floor Singapore office, fly through the glass to Tide Arena over Marina Bay. Watch a NyxID request go from HTTP 200 to 401, then follow the five-layer vehicle and nine AI employee roles through a launch rehearsal. “One more thing” takes the flight into orbit to the independent observatory of The Omega Institute, where a live Lean 4 proof checks the Fredkin counterexample. Marina Bay and a spiral galaxy share the final frame.
summary_zh: 镜头从新加坡办公室 14 楼穿窗而出，飞向滨海湾上空的星潮剧场。看 NyxID 请求的响应从 HTTP 200 变为 401，再看五层整车架构与九个 AI 员工岗位如何支撑发布会彩排。一句“One more thing”将镜头带入轨道，抵达独立科研机构 The Omega Institute 的观测站，现场用 Lean 4 验证 Fredkin 反例。终幕分屏并置滨海湾与螺旋星系。
subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
style: Forward-only 30 fps 3D flights and live product captures, phrase-timed glass telemetry, bilingual cinema subtitles and a split-screen Marina Bay / spiral galaxy coda.
